checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Matte black bottle with cap stays recognizable in all frames.

must.item: Visibly turns slowly through roughly a quarter turn
must.why: The cap loop and latch rotate into view across frames, which shows a turn. The bottle also drifts right a little, but it is mostly a rotation.

must.item: Stays upright without melting or changing proportions
must.why: It stays upright. The cap detail changes, and the bottle looks slightly wider and shifts a bit, but the shape holds.
The background and table look the same in every frame. The background has tiny softness changes.
The frames are square. The 6 s length was given. I cannot hear audio, but the setup says there is none.

faults.what: The cap details are invented and shift between frames: a loop handle, then a latch and button. This is a slight AI drift in cap design.
The bottle drifts slightly right and its width grows a little during the turn.
The turn is subtle because the bottle has no markings.

summary: The clip shows the bottle turning gently in place with a still camera and a stable scene. The cap details are invented and shift, and the bottle drifts slightly sideways.
